name: Easter Island (Rapa Nui), Chile
clues: Giant stone heads on a far-away isle, / alone in the Pacific for many a mile.
I'm a lonely triangle of land in the South Pacific that belongs to a long, thin country in South America. What am I?
Giant carved heads called moai. Part of Chile, deep in the Pacific.
fact: Most moai face inland, watching over the villages that carved them.

name: Hermitage Museum, St Petersburg, Russia
clues: A green-and-white palace that's full of fine art, / by a river up north, in a city's old heart.
I'm one of the world's biggest art museums, in Russia's old imperial capital on the Baltic. What am I?
A giant art museum on the Neva River.
fact: The Hermitage was founded by Catherine the Great in 1764.

name: Taipei 101, Taiwan
clues: A skyscraper stacked like a tall bamboo stem, / on an island in Asia, I'm its city's gem.
My name is a number, and I tower over the capital of an island off the coast of China. What am I?
A skyscraper in Taiwan's capital.
fact: Taipei 101 was the tallest building in the world from 2004 to 2010.

name: Plitvice Lakes, Croatia
clues: Blue lakes on a staircase that waterfalls link, / in a forest in Europe, they're bluer than ink.
I'm a national park of terraced lakes, inland from the Adriatic coast, in the Balkans. What am I?
A national park of terraced lakes in Croatia.
fact: The lakes are separated by natural dams of travertine that are still growing.

name: Okavango Delta, Botswana
clues: A river in Africa that never meets sea, / it spreads into swamps where the elephants roam free.
I'm a huge green wetland in the middle of the Kalahari, in a country north of South Africa. What am I?
A giant inland delta in Botswana.
fact: The Okavango floods at the height of the dry season, because the rain falls months earlier in Angola.

name: Matterhorn, Switzerland and Italy
clues: A sharp, crooked peak in the snow of the Alps, / like a shark fin of rock, every climber it helps.
I'm a pyramid-shaped mountain on the border between Switzerland and Italy. What am I?
A pyramid-shaped peak above Zermatt.
fact: The Matterhorn was first climbed in 1865 by Edward Whymper's team.

name: Meteora, Greece
clues: Monasteries perched on tall pillars of stone, / in a land of old gods, they look down all alone.
I'm a group of monasteries on top of huge rock towers in central Greece. What am I?
Monasteries on top of rock pillars in central Greece.
fact: Six of Meteora's monasteries are still active today.

name: Chichen Itza, Mexico
clues: A stepped stone pyramid in jungle-green land, / built by the Maya with skill, it still stands.
I'm a famous ruined city on a flat peninsula in southeastern Mexico. What am I?
The great Maya pyramid of El Castillo in the Yucatán.
fact: El Castillo has 91 steps on each of its four sides, plus the top platform, for 365 in all.

name: Golden Gate Bridge, San Francisco, USA
clues: I'm not made of gold though my name tells you so, / I stretch through the fog where the big ships go.
I'm a red-orange bridge on the US west coast, at the mouth of a bay in California. What am I?
A red-orange suspension bridge across a Californian strait.
fact: When it opened in 1937, the Golden Gate had the longest main span of any suspension bridge in the world.

name: Charles Bridge, Prague, Czechia
clues: An old stone bridge lined with statues of saints, / in a city of spires that artists love to paint.
I'm a medieval bridge in the capital of the Czech Republic. What am I?
A medieval stone bridge over the Vltava River.
fact: Construction of Charles Bridge began in 1357.

name: Cliffs of Moher, Ireland
clues: Tall cliffs at the edge of a green, rainy isle, / where the Atlantic crashes and puffins stay a while.
I'm a wall of sea cliffs on the west coast of Ireland. What am I?
Famous sea cliffs in County Clare, Ireland.
fact: The Cliffs of Moher stretch for about 14 km.

name: Giant's Causeway, Northern Ireland
clues: Thousands of six-sided columns of stone, / like steps for a giant, on a coast cold and lone.
I'm a coast of basalt columns at the northern tip of Northern Ireland. What am I?
Basalt columns on the coast of County Antrim.
fact: The columns formed about 60 million years ago when lava cooled and cracked.

name: Perito Moreno Glacier, Argentina
clues: A wall of blue ice, it's as tall as a tower, / it cracks into a lake, and it rumbles each hour.
I'm a giant glacier in Patagonia, near the southern tip of South America, in Argentina. What am I?
A giant glacier in Los Glaciares National Park, in Argentine Patagonia.
fact: Perito Moreno's ice wall rises about 70 m above the lake, and chunks crash off it all day.

name: Machu Picchu, Peru
clues: A city of stone on a mountain so high, / hidden in clouds where the condors fly.
I'm the most famous Inca ruin, high in the Andes of Peru. What am I?
The Inca citadel in the Andes of Peru.
fact: Machu Picchu was built in the 1400s, likely as an estate for the Inca emperor Pachacuti.

name: Iguazu Falls, Argentina and Brazil
clues: Hundreds of waterfalls thunder as one, / in a rainforest glowing with mist and with sun.
I'm a giant set of waterfalls on the border of Argentina and Brazil. What am I?
Giant waterfalls on the Argentina and Brazil border.
fact: Iguazu is made of about 275 separate waterfalls spread over nearly 3 km.

name: Milford Sound, New Zealand
clues: Waterfalls tumble down cliffs to the sea, / in a deep, misty fjord, where the dolphins swim free.
I'm a fjord at the bottom of the world, on the southwest coast of New Zealand's South Island. What am I?
A deep fjord in the far southwest of New Zealand's South Island.
fact: Milford Sound gets about 6.8 m of rain a year, making it one of the wettest places on Earth.

name: Golden Temple, Amritsar, India
clues: A temple of gold that sits in a pool, / where all can eat free, that's the welcoming rule.
I'm the holiest place of the Sikhs, in the Punjab region of northern India. What am I?
The holiest shrine of Sikhism, covered in gold.
fact: Anyone can eat at the Golden Temple's langar, whatever their religion.

name: Serengeti, Tanzania
clues: Endless gold grass where the wildebeest run, / and lions lie lazing in hot African sun.
I'm a huge savanna in East Africa, in the country of Kilimanjaro. What am I?
A famous savanna national park in Tanzania.
fact: The great migration includes about 1.5 million wildebeest plus hundreds of thousands of zebras.

name: Twelve Apostles, Australia
clues: Tall rocks in the ocean, all battered by waves, / near a long coastal road, by the sea's great caves.
We're limestone towers standing in the sea along the south coast of Australia. What am I?
Limestone stacks along the Great Ocean Road.
fact: The cliffs here retreat about 2 cm a year.

name: Great Pyramid of Giza, Egypt
clues: The oldest of wonders, a triangle of stone, / by the desert and Nile, I've been standing alone.
I'm the biggest pyramid on Earth, just outside the capital of Egypt. What am I?
The great pyramids just outside Cairo.
fact: The Great Pyramid was originally covered in polished white limestone that made it shine in the sun.

name: Pamukkale, Turkey
clues: White terraces looking like fresh fallen snow, / filled with warm pools where the bathers all go.
I'm a hillside of white mineral pools in western Türkiye. What am I?
Pamukkale, in southwestern Turkey.
fact: Visitors to Pamukkale must walk the terraces barefoot to protect the soft travertine.

name: Uluru, Australia
clues: A huge red rock in a flat desert land, / it glows at sunset over the sand.
I'm a giant sandstone rock in the middle of Australia's outback. What am I?
Uluru, also called Ayers Rock.
fact: Uluru is about 348 m high and 9.4 km around at its base.

name: Bran Castle, Romania
clues: A castle on a cliff where the dark forests grow, / tied to a vampire's tale that everyone knows.
I'm called Dracula's Castle, in the mountains of Transylvania, Romania. What am I?
A castle in the Carpathians near Brașov.
fact: Bram Stoker never visited Romania.

name: Stonehenge, England
clues: A ring of huge stones on a wide grassy plain, / built long ago, and it's lined up with the sun again.
I'm a prehistoric stone circle in southern England. What am I?
Stonehenge, on Salisbury Plain.
fact: Stonehenge's biggest stones, the sarsens, weigh around 25 tonnes each.

name: Naqsh-e Jahan Square, Isfahan, Iran
clues: A giant old square with blue domes all around, / in a city once called half the world, so renowned.
I'm a royal square in a city in the middle of Iran, south of Tehran. What am I?
The great square of Isfahan, Iran, lined with blue-tiled mosques.
fact: It's one of the largest city squares in the world, about 560 m long.

name: Banaue Rice Terraces, Philippines
clues: Green steps of rice climbing up mountain walls, / carved by hand long ago, they're the stairs of the halls.
I'm a mountainside of ancient rice terraces on the largest island of the Philippines. What am I?
Ancient rice terraces in the mountains of northern Luzon, Philippines.
fact: The Ifugao people carved these terraces by hand about 2,000 years ago.

name: Grand Palace, Bangkok, Thailand
clues: Gold spires and roofs in a bright royal maze, / by a river in Asia, it glitters for days.
I'm the royal palace in the capital of Thailand. What am I?
The royal palace of Bangkok, home of the Emerald Buddha.
fact: The Grand Palace was home to Thailand's kings from 1782.

name: St Peter's Basilica, Vatican City
clues: A great dome above a huge square of stone, / in the world's smallest country, a church of its own.
I'm the Pope's great church, in a tiny country inside Rome. What am I?
The great church of the Pope.
fact: Vatican City covers just 0.44 square kilometers.

name: Kīlauea, Hawaii, USA
clues: I spill glowing lava to make brand-new land, / on an island where surfers ride waves on the sand.
I'm a volcano on the Big Island of Hawaii. What am I?
A volcano on Hawaii's Big Island.
fact: Kīlauea erupted almost continuously from 1983 to 2018.

name: Venice, Italy
clues: My streets are of water, my taxis are boats, / I'm sinking a little, but still stay afloat.
I'm a city of canals and gondolas in northeast Italy. What am I?
The Italian city of gondolas and canals.
fact: The wooden piles under Venice have lasted centuries because, without oxygen underwater, they slowly turned almost to stone.

name: Great Blue Hole, Belize
clues: A deep circle of blue in a turquoise sea, / where divers drop down into darkness to see.
I'm a giant round sinkhole in the Caribbean, off the coast of a small country next to Mexico. What am I?
The Great Blue Hole, off the coast of Belize.
fact: The Great Blue Hole is about 300 m across and 125 m deep.

name: Acropolis, Athens, Greece
clues: A temple of columns that stands on a hill, / above an old city that's busy still.
I'm the rocky hill of ancient temples above the capital of Greece. What am I?
The rock above Athens, crowned by the Parthenon.
fact: The Parthenon was finished in 432 BC and dedicated to the goddess Athena.

name: Mont-Saint-Michel, France
clues: An abbey on a rock, sometimes island, sometimes not, / when the tide rushes out, you can walk to the spot.
I'm a tidal island topped by an abbey, off the coast of Normandy, France. What am I?
A tidal island abbey off the coast of Normandy.
fact: The tides around Mont-Saint-Michel are among the strongest in Europe, up to 14 m.

name: Zhangjiajie, China
clues: Tall pillars of stone that rise out of the mist, / like a floating world that no artist could resist.
I'm a forest of sandstone towers in the province of Hunan, in China. What am I?
A forest park of stone towers in Hunan.
fact: One pillar was renamed 'Avatar Hallelujah Mountain' in 2010.

name: Old Faithful, Yellowstone, USA
clues: A spout of hot water that shoots to the sky, / right on time, so the tourists all wait nearby.
I'm the most famous geyser in America's first national park, in Wyoming. What am I?
The famous geyser in the world's first national park.
fact: Old Faithful erupts roughly every 60 to 110 minutes.

name: Terracotta Army, Xi'an, China
clues: An army of soldiers all made out of clay, / buried to guard their old emperor's way.
I'm thousands of clay warriors near Xi'an, in China. What am I?
Clay warriors guarding China's first emperor.
fact: About 8,000 soldiers, 130 chariots and 670 horses are thought to be buried there.

name: Varanasi, India
clues: Steps down to a river where pilgrims all pray, / and candles float off at the end of the day.
I'm a holy city on the Ganges, in northern India. What am I?
One of the oldest living cities, on the Ganges.
fact: Varanasi has more than 80 ghats along the Ganges.

name: Sossusvlei, Namibia
clues: Tall dunes of red sand by the coast, on fire, / with dead trees below them, they never expire.
I'm a valley of giant red dunes in the Namib Desert, in southwest Africa. What am I?
Red sand dunes in the Namib Desert.
fact: The Namib is often called the oldest desert in the world, at around 55 million years.

name: Bagan, Myanmar
clues: Thousands of temples spread over a plain, / with balloons drifting over at dawn once again.
I'm an ancient city of temples on a river in Myanmar. What am I?
An ancient temple city on the Irrawaddy River in Myanmar.
fact: Over 10,000 temples were built at Bagan between the 11th and 13th centuries.

name: Taj Mahal, India
clues: A white marble tomb that was built out of love, / with a dome and four towers, and gardens above.
I'm the most famous building in India, in the city of Agra. What am I?
The Taj Mahal in Agra.
fact: The four minarets of the Taj Mahal lean slightly outward so they would fall away from the tomb in an earthquake.

name: Statue of Liberty, New York, USA
clues: A green copper lady who holds up a light, / she welcomes the ships that arrive day and night.
I'm a giant statue on an island in New York Harbor. What am I?
A torch-bearing gift from France in New York Harbor.
fact: The Statue of Liberty's index finger is about 2.4 m long.

name: Hassan II Mosque, Casablanca, Morocco
clues: A mosque by the ocean, its minaret high, / its floor reaches out over waves rolling by.
I'm a huge mosque on the Atlantic coast, in the biggest city of Morocco. What am I?
A huge seaside mosque in Casablanca, Morocco.
fact: Its minaret is about 210 m tall, one of the tallest in the world.

name: Kruger National Park, South Africa
clues: Where lions and elephants and leopards all roam, / a giant safari park makes them a home.
I'm the biggest wildlife park in South Africa, on the border with Mozambique. What am I?
South Africa's biggest safari park, on the border with Mozambique.
fact: Kruger is home to all of the Big Five: lion, leopard, elephant, rhino and buffalo.

name: Mount Kilimanjaro, Tanzania
clues: The highest in Africa, with snow on my crown, / though I stand near the equator, looking down.
I'm a huge volcano in Tanzania, near the border with Kenya. What am I?
Africa's highest peak, in Tanzania.
fact: Kilimanjaro's summit, Uhuru Peak, is 5,895 m above sea level.

name: Hollywood Sign, Los Angeles, USA
clues: Big white letters on a hill in the sun, / above the city where the movies are done.
I'm a famous sign on a hillside in Los Angeles. What am I?
White letters on a hillside above Los Angeles.
fact: The sign originally read HOLLYWOODLAND. The last four letters were removed in 1949.

name: Wadi Rum, Jordan
clues: A red desert valley where camels stroll by, / it looks just like Mars under a deep blue sky.
I'm a red sandstone desert in the south of Jordan, called the Valley of the Moon. What am I?
The Valley of the Moon desert in southern Jordan.
fact: Wadi Rum has stood in for Mars in films like The Martian.

name: Rainbow Mountain (Vinicunca), Peru
clues: A mountain of stripes, red and yellow and green, / high in the Andes, the strangest you've seen.
I'm a rainbow-striped mountain in Peru, a day trip from the old Inca capital Cusco. What am I?
A striped mountain in the Andes, a day trip from Cusco, Peru.
fact: Vinicunca's top is about 5,200 m high, and its stripes are layers of different minerals.

name: Chocolate Hills, Bohol, Philippines
clues: Over a thousand round hills in a row, / turn brown in the dry months, like sweets, you know.
I'm a field of cone-shaped hills on an island in the Philippines, named after a treat. What am I?
Cone-shaped hills on Bohol island.
fact: There are at least 1,260 Chocolate Hills.

name: Lake Baikal, Russia
clues: The deepest of lakes, it's so old and so clear, / in the cold heart of Asia, it freezes each year.
I'm the world's deepest lake, in Siberia, Russia. What am I?
Lake Baikal.
fact: Lake Baikal is about 25 million years old and more than 1,600 m deep.

name: Nazca Lines, Peru
clues: Huge drawings of animals scratched in the sand, / you can see them best from a plane, not from land.
I'm a set of giant desert drawings in southern Peru. What am I?
Giant desert drawings in southern Peru.
fact: The lines have survived so long because the area gets almost no rain or wind.

name: Petra, Jordan
clues: A city of rose-colored rock in a canyon, / with temples carved into cliffs, every one a companion.
I'm an ancient city carved into cliffs in southern Jordan. What am I?
The ancient Nabataean city of Petra.
fact: Scientists estimate that around 85% of Petra is still buried and unexcavated.

name: Great Wall of China (Badaling)
clues: A long stone wall winding over the hills, / it was built to keep out invaders, it guards them still.
I'm the world's longest wall, and my most visited part is near Beijing. What am I?
The Great Wall of China, at Badaling near Beijing.
fact: All the sections of the Great Wall added together stretch about 21,000 km.

name: Mount Bromo, Indonesia
clues: A smoking volcano that rises from sand, / at dawn people climb it to watch the sun land.
I'm an active volcano surrounded by a sea of sand, on the island of Java, Indonesia. What am I?
An active volcano in East Java.
fact: The Tenggerese people hold the Yadnya Kasada festival at Bromo every year.

name: Bora Bora, French Polynesia
clues: A green island peak in a blue lagoon, / with huts on the water, a honeymoon boon.
I'm an island in French Polynesia, in the South Pacific. What am I?
An island in French Polynesia.
fact: Overwater bungalows were invented in French Polynesia in the 1960s.

name: Li River at Xingping, Guilin, China
clues: Green peaks like dragon teeth line a calm river, / where bamboo rafts drift on the water's mirror.
I'm a river through karst peaks in southern China, and my view is on the 20-yuan note. What am I?
Karst peaks along the Li River near Guilin, in southern China.
fact: This view of the Li River is printed on the back of China's 20-yuan note.

name: Victoria Peak, Hong Kong
clues: A hill over towers that sparkle at night, / ride a steep tram to the top for the light.
I'm the highest hill on Hong Kong Island. What am I?
The highest hill on Hong Kong Island.
fact: Hong Kong has more skyscrapers than any other city in the world.

name: Rock of Gibraltar
clues: A huge rock of limestone where two seas meet, / wild monkeys on top will steal what you eat.
I'm a British rock at the southern tip of Spain, facing Africa. What am I?
A British limestone rock at the tip of Spain.
fact: About 300 Barbary macaques live on the Rock of Gibraltar.

name: Leaning Tower of Pisa, Italy
clues: A white tower leaning that never quite falls, / where tourists pretend to hold up its walls.
I'm a leaning bell tower in the Tuscany region of Italy. What am I?
A tilted bell tower in Tuscany.
fact: The tower took about 200 years to build, partly because wars kept stopping the work.

name: Hoi An, Vietnam
clues: An old trading town where the lanterns glow bright, / on a river in Asia, it shines every night.
I'm a lantern-lit old town on the coast of central Vietnam. What am I?
An old lantern-lit trading town on the coast of central Vietnam.
fact: Hoi An's Japanese Covered Bridge dates from the 1590s.

name: Edinburgh Castle, Scotland
clues: A castle that sits on a rock, old and high, / above a city of hills and a gray northern sky.
I'm the castle above the capital of Scotland. What am I?
The castle on the rock above Scotland's capital.
fact: The One O'Clock Gun has been fired since 1861 so ships could set their clocks.

name: Christ the Redeemer, Rio de Janeiro
clues: A statue with arms open wide on a peak, / above a big city of beaches, unique.
I'm a giant statue on a mountain above Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. What am I?
The Christ the Redeemer statue in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.
fact: Christ the Redeemer was finished in 1931 and is about 30 m tall, not counting its pedestal.

name: Sagrada Família, Barcelona, Spain
clues: A church like a forest, with towers so tall, / still being built after a century in all.
I'm Gaudí's unfinished basilica in Barcelona, Spain. What am I?
Gaudí's giant basilica in Barcelona.
fact: Antoni Gaudí worked on the Sagrada Família for more than 40 years, until his death in 1926.

name: Gyeongbokgung Palace, Seoul, South Korea
clues: A palace of wood with its rooftops that curve, / in a big modern city, its guards stand to serve.
I'm the main royal palace of Seoul, South Korea. What am I?
The main royal palace of Seoul, South Korea.
fact: Gyeongbokgung was first built in 1395, and visitors wearing hanbok get in free.

name: Mount Fuji, Japan
clues: A perfect white cone that the painters adore, / the tallest of mountains on my island shore.
I'm a snow-capped volcano and the highest mountain in Japan. What am I?
A snow-capped volcano and the tallest peak in Japan.
fact: Mount Fuji is 3,776 m tall, and the official climbing season lasts only about two months each summer.

name: Caminito, La Boca, Buenos Aires
clues: A street of tin houses in red, blue and green, / where tango is danced, the most colorful scene.
I'm a colorful street by the port of Buenos Aires, Argentina. What am I?
The colorful street of La Boca in Buenos Aires, Argentina.
fact: La Boca's tin houses were painted with leftover ship paint, which is why they're so colorful.

name: Brandenburg Gate, Berlin, Germany
clues: A great stone gate with a chariot on top, / where a wall split a city, then it had to stop.
I'm a famous gate in the center of Berlin, Germany. What am I?
The famous gate in the heart of Berlin.
fact: The Berlin Wall ran right beside the Brandenburg Gate from 1961 to 1989.

name: Valley of the Kings, Luxor, Egypt
clues: A desert valley hiding tombs of old kings, / with gold and with mummies and treasures and rings.
I'm the burial valley of the pharaohs, across the Nile from Luxor, Egypt. What am I?
The royal tombs across the Nile from Luxor, Egypt.
fact: Tutankhamun's tomb was found here almost untouched in 1922.

name: Angkor Wat, Cambodia
clues: The world's biggest temple, with towers like flowers, / it rises from jungle and moats, and it towers.
I'm the great temple on the flag of Cambodia. What am I?
Angkor Wat temple in Cambodia.
fact: Angkor Wat faces west, which is unusual for a temple of its kind, and the sun rises right behind its towers at the equinox.

name: Dead Sea
clues: A lake so salty that you float like a log, / at the lowest place on land, through the haze and the fog.
I'm a salt lake between Jordan and Israel, the lowest point on land. What am I?
A lake so salty it is called 'dead'.
fact: The Dead Sea's shore is about 430 m below sea level and the water level drops about 1 m a year.

name: Hampi, India
clues: Big round boulders all piled on a plain, / with ruins of temples where kings used to reign.
I'm the ruins of an old royal city in southern India, among giant boulders. What am I?
The ruins of the Vijayanagara capital in Karnataka.
fact: Hampi's stone chariot at the Vittala Temple appears on India's 50-rupee note.

name: Kirkjufell, Iceland
clues: A cone-shaped green mountain beside the sea, / with waterfalls in front, it's a photo for free.
I'm the most photographed mountain in Iceland, on a peninsula in the west. What am I?
A cone-shaped mountain on Iceland's Snæfellsnes peninsula.
fact: Kirkjufell means 'church mountain'.

name: Badwater Basin, Death Valley, USA
clues: The lowest of all, white with salt and with heat, / a dry valley where the sun can't be beat.
I'm a salt flat in Death Valley, California, the lowest point in North America. What am I?
A salt flat in Death Valley, California.
fact: Mount Whitney, the highest point in the lower 48 states, is less than 140 km from Badwater.

name: Tiger's Nest Monastery, Bhutan
clues: A monastery clinging to cliffs in the sky, / in a small mountain kingdom, so very high.
I'm a cliffside monastery in Bhutan, in the Himalayas. What am I?
Paro Taktsang, a monastery in Bhutan.
fact: Bhutan measures its progress with Gross National Happiness.

name: Victoria Falls, Zambia and Zimbabwe
clues: A mile-wide curtain of water that roars, / and the mist rises up like smoke as it pours.
I'm a giant waterfall on the border of Zambia and Zimbabwe. What am I?
Victoria Falls on the Zambezi River.
fact: At full flood, more than 500 million liters of water per minute pour over Victoria Falls.

name: Lalibela, Ethiopia
clues: Churches carved down into rock in the ground, / in an African highland, where pilgrims are found.
I'm a town of rock-cut churches in the highlands of Ethiopia. What am I?
Rock-hewn churches in the Ethiopian highlands.
fact: Lalibela's 11 churches were carved around the 12th and 13th centuries and are still used for worship.

name: CN Tower, Toronto, Canada
clues: A needle of concrete that stands by a lake, / walk on its glass floor if your legs don't shake.
I'm a giant tower beside Lake Ontario, in Canada's biggest city. What am I?
The tall tower by Lake Ontario in Toronto, Canada.
fact: The CN Tower is 553 m tall and has a glass floor 342 m up.

name: Times Square, New York City
clues: Bright billboards that flash all the night and the day, / where a ball drops at New Year and crowds come to play.
I'm the brightest intersection in Manhattan, New York City. What am I?
Times Square, Manhattan.
fact: The New Year's Eve ball drop in Times Square started in 1907.

name: Shibuya Crossing, Tokyo, Japan
clues: When the lights all turn green, a thousand feet stride, / in a giant neon city, from every side.
I'm the world's busiest pedestrian crossing, in Tokyo, Japan. What am I?
The world's busiest pedestrian crossing, in Tokyo.
fact: The dog Hachikō waited at Shibuya Station for his owner every day for nearly ten years.

name: Preikestolen, Norway
clues: A flat-topped cliff high over a fjord, / dangle your feet if you're not easily floored.
I'm a square cliff 600 m above a fjord in southwest Norway. What am I?
A cliff above the Lysefjord in Norway.
fact: About 300,000 people hike to Preikestolen each year.

name: Alhambra, Granada, Spain
clues: A red palace of fountains and gardens and tile, / on a hill in the south, built in Moorish style.
I'm a Moorish palace above the city of Granada, Spain. What am I?
A Moorish palace above Granada.
fact: The Alhambra was the last stronghold of Muslim rule in Spain, until 1492.

name: Torres del Paine, Chile
clues: Three granite towers in a land of strong wind, / with glaciers and lakes, where the guanacos grinned.
I'm a national park of granite peaks in Patagonia, in Chile. What am I?
A national park in Chilean Patagonia.
fact: 'Paine' is thought to mean 'blue' in the local Tehuelche language.

name: Registan, Samarkand, Uzbekistan
clues: Three blue-tiled schools on a sandy old square, / on the ancient Silk Road, there's history there.
I'm a grand square of blue-tiled buildings in Samarkand, Uzbekistan. What am I?
The famous square of Samarkand.
fact: Registan means 'sandy place' in Persian.

name: Komodo Island, Indonesia
clues: An island of dragons, real ones, it's true, / huge lizards that hunt, and they'd hunt you too.
I'm an island in Indonesia, home of the biggest lizards on Earth. What am I?
An island in the Lesser Sunda chain, home of dragons.
fact: Komodo dragons can grow to 3 m long.

name: Tikal, Guatemala
clues: Tall Maya temples rise out of the trees, / where howler monkeys yell in the jungle breeze.
I'm a great Maya city in the jungle of northern Guatemala. What am I?
A great Maya city in the jungle of northern Guatemala.
fact: Tikal appeared as the Rebel base on Yavin 4 in the first Star Wars film in 1977.

name: Ilulissat Icefjord, Greenland
clues: Icebergs as tall as skyscrapers float, / in a frozen fjord, too big for a boat.
I'm a fjord full of icebergs on the west coast of Greenland. What am I?
An icefjord on Greenland's west coast.
fact: Sermeq Kujalleq glacier produces about 10% of Greenland's icebergs.

name: Colosseum, Rome, Italy
clues: A giant stone arena where gladiators fought, / in the Eternal City, it's the sight that's sought.
I'm the great ancient amphitheater in the middle of Rome, Italy. What am I?
The great amphitheater of the Roman emperors.
fact: Much of the Colosseum's missing stone was taken to build other buildings in Rome, including St Peter's.

name: Ushuaia, Argentina
clues: The end of the world, that's the name that I go by, / a city of mountains under a cold southern sky.
I'm the southernmost city, on the island of Tierra del Fuego, in Argentina. What am I?
The southernmost city on the island of Tierra del Fuego.
fact: Ushuaia was founded around a prison, which is now a museum.

name: Borobudur, Indonesia
clues: A mountain of stone with stupas like bells, / on an island of volcanoes, a story it tells.
I'm the largest Buddhist temple in the world, on the island of Java, Indonesia. What am I?
The largest Buddhist temple in the world, on the island of Java.
fact: Borobudur was built in the 9th century from about two million stone blocks.

name: Havana, Cuba
clues: Old cars in bright colors cruise by the sea, / with music and dancing, come salsa with me.
I'm the capital of the largest island in the Caribbean. What am I?
The capital of Cuba.
fact: Old Havana and its fortifications became a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1982.

name: Table Mountain, Cape Town, South Africa
clues: A mountain so flat that a cloud makes its cloth, / above a big city at Africa's south.
I'm a flat-topped mountain above Cape Town, South Africa. What am I?
The flat-topped mountain above Cape Town.
fact: The constellation Mensa, 'the table', was named after Table Mountain in the 1750s.

name: Angel Falls, Venezuela
clues: The tallest of waterfalls, from a table of stone, / it drops from the clouds to a jungle unknown.
I'm the highest waterfall on Earth, in the jungle of Venezuela. What am I?
The world's tallest waterfall, in Venezuela.
fact: Angel Falls drops 979 m, with an unbroken fall of 807 m.

name: Dubrovnik, Croatia
clues: An old walled city with roofs orange and red, / on a blue sea in Europe, with walls you can tread.
I'm a walled old town on the Adriatic coast of Croatia. What am I?
A walled old town on the Adriatic coast.
fact: Dubrovnik's walls are nearly 2 km around and up to 25 m high.

name: Badshahi Mosque, Lahore, Pakistan
clues: A great red mosque with white domes in a row, / in a city of gardens where the Punjab rivers flow.
I'm a huge red sandstone mosque in Lahore, Pakistan. What am I?
The great red sandstone mosque of Lahore, Pakistan.
fact: Finished in 1673, its courtyard can hold around 100,000 people.

name: Cartagena, Colombia
clues: Colorful houses inside an old wall, / on the Caribbean coast, with balconies tall.
I'm a walled port city on the Caribbean coast of Colombia. What am I?
A walled Caribbean port city in Colombia.
fact: Cartagena's city walls stretch about 11 km.

name: Lake Titicaca, Peru and Bolivia
clues: The highest big lake where boats sail on through, / with islands of reeds and a sky deep and blue.
I'm a huge lake high in the Andes, shared by Peru and Bolivia. What am I?
The highest navigable lake in the world, between Peru and Bolivia.
fact: Lake Titicaca sits about 3,812 m above sea level.

name: Chefchaouen, Morocco
clues: A town in the mountains, all painted in blue, / with stairways and alleys in every hue.
I'm the blue city in the mountains of northern Morocco. What am I?
The blue city of northern Morocco.
fact: Chefchaouen was founded in 1471 as a small fortress.

name: Great Barrier Reef, Australia
clues: The biggest coral reef, seen even from space, / with turtles and fish in a warm, sunny place.
I'm a giant coral reef off the northeast coast of Australia. What am I?
The giant coral reef off Queensland.
fact: The Great Barrier Reef is made of about 2,900 individual reefs.

name: Pompeii, Italy
clues: A Roman town buried in ash in a day, / by the volcano nearby, that's still there today.
I'm an ancient Roman town at the foot of Mount Vesuvius, near Naples, Italy. What am I?
A Roman town at the foot of Mount Vesuvius.
fact: Pompeii was rediscovered in the 1700s, about 1,600 years after it was buried.

name: Moraine Lake, Canada
clues: A lake that's bright turquoise below jagged peaks, / it's frozen for most of the year, many weeks.
I'm a glacier lake in the Rocky Mountains of Canada, in Banff National Park. What am I?
A glacier lake below ten peaks in Banff National Park.
fact: Moraine Lake is usually frozen until June.

name: Las Vegas Strip, USA
clues: A desert street glowing with lights all night long, / with copies of wonders, where you'll win or go wrong.
I'm the street of casinos in the desert of Nevada, USA. What am I?
The neon street of casinos in Nevada.
fact: The beam of light from the top of the Luxor pyramid is among the strongest in the world.

name: St Basil's Cathedral, Moscow, Russia
clues: Colorful onion domes, swirled like a treat, / at the end of a square where the Kremlin you'll meet.
I'm the colorful cathedral on Red Square, in Moscow, Russia. What am I?
The colorful cathedral on Red Square.
fact: St Basil's was built in the 1550s to celebrate a military victory by Ivan the Terrible.

name: Forbidden City, Beijing, China
clues: A giant red palace with golden roof tiles, / where emperors lived, through gates for miles.
I'm the old imperial palace in the heart of Beijing, China. What am I?
The imperial palace in the heart of Beijing.
fact: The Forbidden City was home to 24 emperors of the Ming and Qing dynasties.

name: Hawa Mahal, Jaipur, India
clues: A pink palace with hundreds of windows so small, / in a city of pink, it's the prettiest wall.
I'm the Palace of Winds in Jaipur, in India's desert state of Rajasthan. What am I?
The pink Palace of Winds in Jaipur, India.
fact: Hawa Mahal has 953 small windows, so royal women could watch the street without being seen.

name: Mount Everest
clues: The highest of mountains, I'm the roof of the world, / with prayer flags flying and snow all swirled.
I'm the highest mountain on Earth, on the border of Nepal and China. What am I?
The highest point on Earth above sea level.
fact: The summit of Everest is made of marine limestone. It was once the floor of an ancient sea.

name: Burj Khalifa, Dubai, UAE
clues: A silver needle that's sewn through the sky, / in a desert of gold, I'm the tallest, so high.
I'm the tallest building in the world, in Dubai. What am I?
The tallest building in the world, in Dubai.
fact: The Burj Khalifa is 828 m tall and opened in 2010.

name: Hiroshima Peace Memorial, Japan
clues: A dome made of bones, it's a ruin that stays, / to remind us of peace, and of war's darkest days.
I'm the ruined dome kept as a peace memorial in a city in western Japan. What am I?
The A-Bomb Dome in Hiroshima.
fact: The dome was one of the few buildings left standing near the hypocenter on 6 August 1945.

name: Amsterdam, Netherlands
clues: Canals in a ring, and more bikes than people, / with houses that lean and an old church steeple.
I'm the capital of the Netherlands, famous for canals. What am I?
The Dutch capital of canals.
fact: Amsterdam's 17th-century canal ring is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

name: Big Ben, London, England
clues: A clock in a tower that chimes on the hour, / by a river and Parliament, the world knows its power.
I'm the famous clock tower in London, England. What am I?
The clock tower at the Houses of Parliament in London.
fact: The tower was renamed Elizabeth Tower in 2012 for Queen Elizabeth II's Diamond Jubilee.

name: Avenue of the Baobabs, Madagascar
clues: Giant trees like they're planted with roots in the sky, / they line a red road as the sunset goes by.
I'm a road of giant baobab trees on the big island off the east coast of Africa. What am I?
A road of giant baobab trees near Morondava.
fact: Six of the world's eight baobab species grow only in Madagascar.

name: Tanah Lot, Bali, Indonesia
clues: A temple that sits on a rock in the waves, / at high tide it's an island, where the sea misbehaves.
I'm a sea temple on a rock off the coast of Bali, Indonesia. What am I?
A sea temple on a rock off the coast of Bali, Indonesia.
fact: At high tide, Tanah Lot's rock becomes a little island.

name: Alcatraz, San Francisco, USA
clues: A prison on a rock in a cold, foggy bay, / no one could swim out, or so people say.
I'm the old prison island in San Francisco Bay. What am I?
The prison island in San Francisco Bay.
fact: Alcatraz was a federal prison from 1934 to 1963. Al Capone was one of its inmates.

name: Niagara Falls, Canada and USA
clues: Three thundering falls on a border, so loud, / with boats sailing close through the mist and the cloud.
I'm a set of giant waterfalls on the border of Canada and the USA. What am I?
Three waterfalls on the border between Ontario and New York.
fact: Annie Edson Taylor was the first person to survive going over Niagara Falls in a barrel.

name: Grand Canyon, Arizona, USA
clues: A canyon so deep, in red layers of stone, / a river carved it over millions of years alone.
I'm a mile-deep canyon in Arizona, USA. What am I?
A mile-deep canyon cut by the Colorado River in Arizona.
fact: The Grand Canyon is about 446 km long and up to 29 km wide.

name: Caño Cristales, Colombia
clues: A river of colors, red, yellow and green, / the most beautiful river that you've ever seen.
I'm the river of five colors in the middle of Colombia. What am I?
The 'river of five colors' in central Colombia.
fact: Its red color comes from a water plant that blooms from about July to November.

name: Teotihuacan, Mexico
clues: Huge pyramids of the Sun and the Moon, / in an ancient lost city, we're visited soon.
I'm an ancient city of giant pyramids just outside Mexico City. What am I?
The Pyramids of the Sun and Moon, near Mexico City.
fact: At its peak around 500 AD, Teotihuacan may have had more than 100,000 people.

name: Galapagos Islands, Ecuador
clues: Islands of tortoises, giant and slow, / where a famous young scientist learned all we know.
I'm a group of volcanic islands on the equator, belonging to Ecuador. What am I?
The Galapagos Islands, part of Ecuador.
fact: Galapagos giant tortoises can live for more than 100 years.

name: Neuschwanstein Castle, Germany
clues: A fairy-tale castle on a hill in the Alps, / with white towers rising like sugar-glazed caps.
I'm the fairy-tale castle in the Alps of Bavaria, Germany. What am I?
A fairy-tale castle in the Bavarian Alps.
fact: King Ludwig II of Bavaria died in 1886, before Neuschwanstein was finished.

name: Atomium, Brussels, Belgium
clues: Nine silver balls that are linked in a chain, / a giant atom you can walk in, again and again.
I'm a giant model of an atom in Brussels, Belgium. What am I?
Nine giant silver balls in Brussels.
fact: The Atomium is 102 m tall, and you can ride an escalator between its spheres.

name: Salar de Uyuni, Bolivia
clues: The world's biggest mirror when the rain lays it bare, / a white desert of salt in the high mountain air.
I'm the biggest salt flat on Earth, high in the Andes of Bolivia. What am I?
The biggest salt flat in the world, high in the Andes of Bolivia.
fact: Salar de Uyuni covers more than 10,000 square kilometers and varies in height by less than a meter.

name: Shwedagon Pagoda, Yangon, Myanmar
clues: A golden stupa that shines like the sun, / in a big Asian city, it's the holiest one.
I'm a giant golden pagoda in Yangon, Myanmar. What am I?
The giant golden stupa of Yangon, Myanmar.
fact: The top of the Shwedagon is set with thousands of diamonds and rubies.

name: Danakil Depression (Dallol), Ethiopia
clues: A land of yellow and green bubbling ground, / the hottest of deserts, where salt pools abound.
I'm a colorful, scorching salt desert in northern Ethiopia, near Eritrea. What am I?
The colorful, scorching salt desert of Dallol, in northern Ethiopia.
fact: Dallol is one of the hottest places people live near, averaging around 35°C over the year.

name: Hallstatt, Austria
clues: A village of postcard houses by a lake, / in the Alps of Europe, it's too pretty to fake.
I'm a lakeside village in the mountains of Austria. What am I?
A lakeside village in the Austrian Alps.
fact: Hallstatt's bone house holds hundreds of painted skulls, because the tiny graveyard ran out of space.

name: Ha Long Bay, Vietnam
clues: Thousands of green islands rise from the sea, / where boats with red sails drift peaceful and free.
I'm a bay of limestone islands in northern Vietnam. What am I?
A bay of green islands in northern Vietnam.
fact: Ha Long means 'descending dragon' in Vietnamese.

name: Belém Tower, Lisbon, Portugal
clues: A white stone tower that stands by the river, / where sailors set off, to the world they'd deliver.
I'm a riverside fortress in Lisbon, Portugal. What am I?
A riverside fortress at the mouth of the Tagus in Lisbon.
fact: The rhino carving is thought to show the rhinoceros sent to Lisbon from India in 1515.

name: Hagia Sophia, Istanbul, Türkiye
clues: A great dome with towers where two worlds meet, / a church, then a mosque, on a city's old street.
I'm the great domed building in old Istanbul, Türkiye. What am I?
The great domed building of old Constantinople.
fact: Hagia Sophia's main dome rises about 55 m above the floor.

name: Persepolis, Iran
clues: Stone columns and stairways of kings long ago, / with carvings of people bringing gifts in a row.
I'm the ruins of the ancient Persian capital, in the south of Iran. What am I?
The ceremonial capital of the ancient Persian Empire.
fact: Persepolis was founded by Darius the Great around 518 BC.

name: Oia, Santorini, Greece
clues: White houses with blue domes on a cliff by the sea, / the sunsets are famous, as famous can be.
I'm a clifftop village on a Greek island in the Aegean Sea. What am I?
White houses and blue domes on a Greek island in the Aegean.
fact: The Minoan eruption of Santorini was one of the largest volcanic eruptions in human history.

name: Sydney Opera House, Australia
clues: White sails on a harbor that never set sail, / by a big famous bridge, it's a musical tale.
I'm the famous opera house on the harbor of Australia's biggest city. What am I?
White sails on a harbour, near a famous bridge nicknamed the Coathanger.
fact: Danish architect Jørn Utzon resigned in 1966 and never returned to see the finished building.

name: Göreme, Cappadocia, Türkiye
clues: Tall rock chimneys where balloons float at dawn, / with cave homes and churches, the fairies have gone.
I'm a valley of fairy chimneys in central Türkiye. What am I?
The land of fairy chimneys in central Türkiye.
fact: Derinkuyu, an underground city nearby, goes down about 85 m and could shelter thousands.

name: Hobbiton, Matamata, New Zealand
clues: Round doors in green hills where the little folk dwell, / in a land made of movies, you know the tale well.
I'm the hobbit village film set on the North Island of New Zealand. What am I?
The hobbit village film set on New Zealand's North Island.
fact: Hobbiton was rebuilt in permanent materials for The Hobbit films and is now a tourist attraction.

name: Sidi Bou Said, Tunisia
clues: A village of white with blue doors by the sea, / on a cliff in North Africa, as pretty as can be.
I'm a blue-and-white clifftop village near the capital of Tunisia. What am I?
A blue-and-white clifftop village near Tunis, Tunisia.
fact: A 1915 rule says the village's houses must stay white with blue doors and shutters.

name: Petronas Towers, Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
clues: Twin silver towers with a bridge in between, / in an Asian city, the tallest twins seen.
I'm the famous twin skyscrapers of Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. What am I?
Malaysia's famous twin skyscrapers.
fact: The Petronas Towers were the tallest buildings in the world from 1998 to 2004.

name: Timbuktu, Mali
clues: A city of mud by the edge of the sand, / where caravans came from far across the land.
I'm a legendary desert city near the Niger River in Mali. What am I?
A legendary desert city in Mali whose name starts with 'Tim'.
fact: Timbuktu's Djinguereber Mosque was built around 1327 and is still made of mud brick.

name: Monaco
clues: A tiny rich country with yachts in the bay, / where race cars roar through the streets in May.
I'm a tiny country on the French Riviera. What am I?
A tiny principality on the French Riviera.
fact: Monaco is the second-smallest country in the world after Vatican City.

name: Fushimi Inari Shrine, Kyoto, Japan
clues: Thousands of orange gates up a hill in a row, / with foxes of stone, it's a tunnel you'll know.
I'm a shrine of thousands of orange gates in Kyoto, Japan. What am I?
Fushimi Inari shrine in Kyoto.
fact: The paths of torii gates at Fushimi Inari wind about 4 km up Mount Inari.

name: Jemaa el-Fnaa, Marrakech, Morocco
clues: A big busy square full of stalls and of smoke, / with snake charmers playing and storytellers' jokes.
I'm the great market square of Marrakech, Morocco. What am I?
The great square of Morocco's Red City.
fact: The square was one of the first places on UNESCO's list of Masterpieces of the Oral and Intangible Heritage of Humanity in 2001.

name: Panama Canal, Panama
clues: Ships climb up water steps, ocean to ocean, / cutting a country in two with their motion.
I'm the canal that links the Atlantic and the Pacific through Central America. What am I?
The canal across a narrow Central American country.
fact: Each ship passing through the Panama Canal uses about 200 million liters of fresh water from Gatun Lake.

name: Masjid al-Haram, Mecca, Saudi Arabia
clues: The holiest mosque, with a black cube inside, / where millions of pilgrims come walking in stride.
I'm the great mosque in Mecca, Saudi Arabia. What am I?
The Great Mosque around the Kaaba, in Mecca, Saudi Arabia.
fact: During the Hajj, around two million pilgrims gather in and around the mosque.

name: Half Dome, Yosemite, USA
clues: A granite dome sliced right down the face, / in a valley of waterfalls, a climber's best place.
I'm a giant granite dome in Yosemite National Park, California. What am I?
A granite dome in Yosemite National Park, California.
fact: Half Dome rises about 1,444 m above the floor of Yosemite Valley.

name: Lake Bled, Slovenia
clues: A lake with an island, a church in the middle, / and a castle on cliffs, as pretty as a riddle.
I'm an alpine lake with a church on an island, in Slovenia. What am I?
An alpine lake with a church on an island, in Slovenia.
fact: Bled's island is the only natural island in Slovenia.

name: Sigiriya, Sri Lanka
clues: A giant rock fortress rising from trees, / you climb past lion paws to the top, if you please.
I'm the Lion Rock fortress on the island of Sri Lanka. What am I?
The Lion Rock fortress in Sri Lanka.
fact: Sigiriya was built by King Kashyapa in the 5th century.

name: Marina Bay Sands, Singapore
clues: Three hotel towers with a ship on their heads, / and a pool in the sky, where the city spreads.
I'm a famous hotel with a rooftop pool on the waterfront of Singapore. What am I?
A famous hotel on the waterfront of a city-state.
fact: Singapore is one of only three surviving city-states.

name: Tulum, Mexico
clues: Maya ruins on a cliff by the turquoise sea, / where iguanas sunbathe as happy as can be.
I'm the seaside Maya ruins on the Caribbean coast of Mexico's Yucatán. What am I?
Maya ruins on a cliff over the Caribbean, in Mexico's Yucatán.
fact: Tulum was one of the last cities the Maya built, and people still lived there when the Spanish arrived.

name: Maya Bay, Thailand
clues: A beach in a cove that's walled in by stone, / so famous from a movie, it needed time alone.
I'm a cove surrounded by cliffs on a small island off southern Thailand. What am I?
A cove on Ko Phi Phi Le in the Andaman Sea.
fact: Maya Bay was closed from 2018 to 2022 to let its coral and sharks recover.

name: Mount Rushmore, USA
clues: Four giant faces carved into a hill, / of presidents, staring and standing still.
I'm the mountain carving of four presidents in South Dakota, USA. What am I?
Four presidents carved into a mountain in South Dakota.
fact: Carving Mount Rushmore took 14 years, from 1927 to 1941, mostly with dynamite.

name: Sundarbans, Bangladesh
clues: A forest of mangroves where tigers can swim, / in the delta of rivers, so muddy and dim.
I'm the world's biggest mangrove forest, in the delta of the Ganges, in Bangladesh. What am I?
The mangrove forest of the Ganges delta in Bangladesh, home of Bengal tigers.
fact: The Sundarbans is the largest mangrove forest in the world, shared by Bangladesh and India.

name: The Bund, Shanghai, China
clues: Old buildings in a row along a river so wide, / face a skyline of futuristic towers on the other side.
I'm the famous waterfront of Shanghai, China. What am I?
Shanghai's famous waterfront.
fact: The Shanghai Tower across the river is the tallest building in China.

name: Potala Palace, Lhasa, Tibet
clues: A red-and-white palace on a hill so high, / on the roof of the world, it touches the sky.
I'm the palace of the Dalai Lamas in Lhasa, Tibet. What am I?
A red-and-white palace in Lhasa.
fact: The Potala Palace is 13 stories tall and was built in the 1600s on an older site.

name: Abu Simbel, Egypt
clues: Four giant kings carved in rock by the Nile, / they sit by a lake, and have sat there a while.
I'm a temple of four giant statues in the far south of Egypt, near Sudan. What am I?
Giant statues of Ramesses II near the Sudan border.
fact: Moving Abu Simbel took four years and a global campaign led by UNESCO.

name: Eiffel Tower, Paris, France
clues: An iron tower that sparkles at night, / in the city of love, and the city of light.
I'm the most famous tower in Paris, France. What am I?
The iron lady on the Champ de Mars.
fact: The Eiffel Tower grows about 15 cm taller in summer as the iron expands in the heat.
